issues.description: Question, we have always gotten ground water pretty bad and I've spent a ton of money trying to correct it and put a drainage system in and during heavy rains seems like it's overflowing into neighborhoods driveway, who also gets MORE water than I do. Again I've put up a fence (caught him on our property few times trying to fix without permission) had our backyard leveled and put up retaining wall and put in drainage and crushed stone - question is from what I've read water going on his side is his responsibility correct? The concern is his driveway is starting to ice up but isn't he liable to taking care of it on his end since it's going onto his property? I’m not pumping anything onto his property it’s the natural curve of property that has always been there.
Street is flooding in this area due to catch basin needs to be cleaned off. (LS)

At 9 south mason st.  Salem ma. there is a huge hole of water . It looks like a swimming pool.  It needs to pump out somebody can drown. If there is a other flood where is the water going to go. City nweds to come and check it out  as soon as possible

Drain in front of my house is full of sand all the way to the top. Any rain snow can not go down the drain as it's to full. So my yard and neighbors gets flooded when it rains and snows.  Please empty the drain.  This has been full of sand for years. When then do there drain cleaning ON my street they NEVER DO THIS ONE. 
Thank you
Resident cleaned the catch basin but put the debris in a white bag. Would like the city to pickup since she cleaned the drain for us. (LS)

378 Dutton rd cross my driveway completely flooded due to malfunctioning (blocked) drainage wells (2 in location, both blocked). In rapidly changing winter weather, that creates even more danger due to conversion to ice quickly. Drainage needs to be fixed ASAP.
We were told the sewer drains would be cleared of the construction barrier material before the first snow storm and they haven't been. This could cause major issues.
The storm drain at 53 Tupelo is not functioning and clearing surface water. Please see the attachments.

Snow piles still blocking street drains on Harding Street, specifically to the Left of 35 Harding Street.  I am elderly and disabled and concerned about the coming cold snap which will create glass ice.

The city of Somerville never finished the project at the intersection of Beacon and Scott, leaving a depression in the pavement so that leaves could not be collected in the Fall. I just collected tons of them to allow the drains to operate. Somerville was negligent throughout the process and the city of Cambridge must hold them responsible to fix the problem. City sweepers cannot get to the debris and leave and this is an important area to prevent flooding.
